# IELTS 7.5 study site
> A free IELTS self-study site aiming at band 7.5 overall (6.5 minimum per skill), for people preparing on their own: 947 study items (489 common-mistake cards, 287 collocations and sentence patterns, 73 speaking dialogues, 44 grammar and pronunciation notes, 43 writing/speaking templates, 11 plan notes) plus original listening, reading, writing and speaking practice and spaced review. Progress stays in your own browser; 10 languages.

- Site: https://siinxu.github.io/ielts-study/
- Languages: zh, zh-Hant, en, ja, ko, es, ms, vi, fr, de (append ?lang=<code>)
- Publisher: Incidental AI (https://incidental.site/)
- Full outline: https://siinxu.github.io/ielts-study/llms-full.txt

## Sections
- Study Plan (plan): 11 items
- Grammar & Accent (grammar): 44 items
- Templates (templates): 43 items
- Conversations (dialogues): 73 items
- Mistake Log (mistakes): 489 items
- Collocations (collocations): 287 items
